  WHY: The `all_gated` verdict can report `resets_at: null` despite an available top-level reset timestamp, contrary to the documented contract.

  PROBLEM: The smoke work job’s 30-minute timeout can expire before the sequential CLI and smoke checks, whose individual timeouts can total more than 30 minutes, complete.
  WHY: The job may terminate before redaction and transcript upload, affecting smoke items but not real dispatched work.
- .github/workflows/claude-pool-worker.yml:200, 396 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The work and report jobs check out pool scripts using mutable `inputs.pool_ref` instead of the immutable SHA recorded by the select job.
  WHY: A ref update during a run can make work and report execute different code from the selected revision; the report job needs a fallback because select may fail.
